name: CRE-Score-v3
description: Third-generation credit risk scorecard for consumer loan applications. Uses bureau data, open banking signals, and application data to produce a probability of default.

name: Affordability-Engine-v2
description: Estimates sustainable lending amount based on declared income, open banking expenditure analysis, and stress-tested repayment capacity at higher interest rates.

name: Fraud-Detect-RT
description: Real-time transaction fraud detection using behavioural biometrics, device fingerprinting, and velocity checks. Scores every card transaction within 200ms.

name: ID-Verify-ML
description: Third-party document verification and liveness detection model embedded via vendor API. Used at onboarding to satisfy KYC obligations.

name: AML-TxMonitor-v1
description: Rule-augmented ML model for suspicious transaction monitoring and SAR triage. Flags unusual patterns in payment flows for analyst review.

name: Collections-Propensity-v2
description: Predicts probability and optimal timing of repayment for accounts in arrears. Drives contact strategy and forbearance offer selection.

name: Churn-Predict-v2
description: Identifies customers at high risk of account closure or product cancellation within 90 days. Used to trigger retention offers.

name: Deposit-Forecast
description: Time series model forecasting net deposit inflows and outflows at a 30-day and 90-day horizon. Feeds into treasury liquidity planning.

name: SME-Credit-Score-v1
description: Credit risk assessment for small business lending. Combines Companies House filing data, open banking cashflow analysis, and director credit profiles.

name: Pricing-Optimiser
description: Dynamic personal loan interest rate optimisation model. Balances risk-adjusted return against market competitiveness and internal portfolio concentration limits.

name: Creditinfo-Bureau-Score
description: Bureau-side ML score produced by Creditinfo Group and ingested as an input feature in CRE-Score-v3. Not owned internally.

name: OpenBanking-Categoriser
description: Vendor NLP model that categorises open banking transaction descriptions into standardised income and expenditure buckets for affordability assessment.

name: Customer-Segment-v1
description: Unsupervised clustering model segmenting retail customers by financial behaviour, product usage, and risk profile. Drives product recommendation logic.

name: Early-Warning-Arrears
description: Identifies accounts showing early financial stress indicators — reduced inflows, increased minimum payments, increased cash withdrawals — before formal arrears entry.

name: ChatSupport-LLM
description: Large language model powering automated customer service responses. Third-party API. Handles account queries, payment questions, and complaint triage.
